The students are able to define operations management, explain the difference between goods and services, explain the difference between production and productivity, calculate single factor productivity and multifactor productivity, identify important variables in increasing productivity and forecast data within the scope of operations management

The students are able to define the product life cycle, explain how goods and services are defined from an operations management perspective, define quality and TQM, explain the four process strategies, define capacity, determine design capacity and effective capacity and utilization rates, identify and explains the seven main factors that influence location decisions and how to determine them, and explains how to achieve a good facility layout for the company

The students are to explain the strategic importance of supply chain management, explain and use the EOQ model, identify optional strategies for developing aggregate plans, explain and calculate and create an MRP structure, and explain the relationship between short-term scheduling, capacity planning, planning aggregate, and master schedule
